rules.title: An Act relative to preventing algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market
rules.requirement: Bill H.5222 would address algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market. The page gives only the title and history, not the bill's definitions, prohibited conduct or penalties.
rules.status_basis: Reported favorably by the House Housing committee on 3/12/2026 and referred to House Ways and Means; not enacted.
